maya: Hey team — quick smoke: I hit intermittent queue jitter on continuous batching when small batches + max_tokens=128. Tail latency spikes ~2-3x every ~30s. Can someone run a throughput test and capture perf profiles & task graph? Repro below.

maya: Repro command:
```
loadgen --profile=on --scenario=continuous-batching --batch_size=8 --max_tokens=128 --duration=90 --qps=220 --model=gpt-neox-20b-q4
```

sam: @maya I'll kick off on staging-nvlink-2 now, will attach perf tar when done. Any preferred pprof flags?

maya: thx @sam. pprof --alloc_objects --profile_seconds=90 and enable kvcache tracing: KV_TRACE=1

jonah: Also add --emit-events to loadgen so we can correlate with queue depth spikes.

perf-bot: Started job loadgen/2060123456 on staging-nvlink-2 (id: lg-789). ETA ~2m. Logs: https://ci.internal/loadgen/lg-789

sam: Ran it — attaching short logs:
```
[00:12] qdepth=2 delay_ms=3
[00:26] qdepth=12 delay_ms=27  <-- spike
[00:58] qdepth=3 delay_ms=4
```

rachel: Could be preemption or lease churn. Any node-level OOM/kube evictions around those timestamps?

sam: kube events clean for that window. No OOMs. CPU steal negligible. GPU utilization jumps then drops during spike.

kevin: Might be batch merging threshold: small windows cause rapid concat/split logic to run. Can we run with DEBUG_CB=1 for one run?

maya: Good call @kevin. If someone can repro with DEBUG_CB=1 and the pprof output we'll look at the scheduling path.

jonah: I'll queue a lightweight sweep that toggles CB_MERGE_THRESHOLD from 0.2 -> 0.5 -> 0.8 and collect qdepth histograms. ETA ~30m.

maya: Awesome. If anyone finds a quick mitigation, a short-term knob to avoid spikes would be to lower target_qps or set min_batch_delay_ms=2. Not ideal long-term.

sam: Uploading perf bundle: https://internal-artifacts/perf/lg-789.tar.gz

perf-bot: Perf bundle processed, flamegraphs at https://perf.internal/flames/lg-789/

maya: Reviewing now. Will post a short PR with a defensive gating to avoid merge/split thrash if we see correlation. Thanks all :pray:
